cases.assertion: An authenticated account can save its preset and key, test model availability, and use it in writing with ordinary platform permission and quota checks.
Reading and saving return only safe metadata for the actor. The key and encrypted record are absent.
A stored key cannot carry over to a changed endpoint. A fresh key requires explicit user submission.
Clients can submit only a recognized preset ID. An injected endpoint is never contacted.
Deleting the actor's configuration is idempotent. Further writing uses the platform default.
